note: Physically he is a good fit and commercially he is not, which is becoming the dominant pattern in this batch. At 30, 5'10" and around 182 lb targeting 165, training three times a week and playing flag football, he is neither deconditioned nor gym-averse, and the ask — lean, visible abs, better stamina, better posture — is squarely good-to-great rather than rescue. Health is the neglected corner of an otherwise functioning life with no crisis in it. He fails both commercial criteria and fails them hard: he is a public-sector case manager housing homeless clients, not a business owner, physician or equivalent, and his own words on income are unambiguous — 'that's way out of my league' and 'I got a lot of bills I can't even afford to think about adding another bill.' His price reference point was a couple of hundred dollars. Nothing in the call process asks about budget before a full presentation, so this mismatch was only discovered at minute 32 of a 37-minute call.
